# Framework

The core of every game: lifecycle, graphics, audio, input, content and time.

[All packages](../README.md)

## DotGame.Framework

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [Angle](Angle.md) | struct | An angle, stored in radians. |
| [Color](Color.md) | struct | A color with float components, stored with premultiplied alpha. |
| [Color32](Color32.md) | struct | A color as four bytes, RGBA in memory: the form of texture pixels, as [`Texture.SetData`](Texture.md#setdata) and `CreateTexture` take them. |
| [Game](Game.md) | class | The base class of a game: its services, the display it draws to, and the hooks it overrides to load, update, draw, and respond to the app's lifecycle. |
| [Rectangle](Rectangle.md) | struct | Describes a 2D rectangle defined by a position and size. |
| [RectangleInt](RectangleInt.md) | struct | Describes a 2D rectangle defined by a position and size, using integer coordinates. |
| [Vector2Int](Vector2Int.md) | struct | A position or size in whole numbers: pixels, usually. |

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [ContentBundle](ContentBundle.md) | class | A named set of content that loads and unloads together, such as a level's. |

## DotGame.Framework.Graphics

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [BlendMode](BlendMode.md) | enum | How a sprite batch's sprites combine with what's behind them. |
| [GraphicsService](GraphicsService.md) | class | Draws: sprite batches, textures, render targets and the scissor. |
| [RenderTargetScope](RenderTargetScope.md) | struct | Goes back to the render target that was in use when disposed, and for a batch's target, to how the batch was drawing to it. |
| [RenderTexture](RenderTexture.md) | class | A texture you can draw into with [`GraphicsService.UseRenderTarget`](GraphicsService.md#userendertarget), then draw like any other texture. |
| [Sampler](Sampler.md) | enum | How a sprite batch reads its textures: blending neighbouring pixels or taking the nearest (for pixel art), and clamping at the edges or repeating (for tiled backgrounds). |
| [ScissorScope](ScissorScope.md) | struct | Goes back to the limit on drawing that was in use when disposed. |
| [Shader](Shader.md) | class | A custom way to draw sprites, compiled by the content pipeline from Slang. |
| [ShaderCustomData](ShaderCustomData.md) | record struct | Four custom values that travel with a sprite to its shader, for settings that differ from sprite to sprite in one batch. |
| [ShaderParameter](ShaderParameter.md) | class | Represents a handle to a shader uniform parameter. |
| [ShaderScope](ShaderScope.md) | struct | Goes back to the shader that was in use when disposed. |
| [SpriteBatch](SpriteBatch.md) | class | Draws sprites, and triangles, efficiently: while the scope from [`Begin`](SpriteBatch.md#begin) lasts, draws that can share state are combined. |
| [SpriteBatchScope](SpriteBatchScope.md) | struct | Ends a sprite batch when disposed. |
| [SpriteBatchSettings](SpriteBatchSettings.md) | record struct | How a sprite batch draws. |
| [SpriteFlip](SpriteFlip.md) | enum | Mirrors a sprite's image inside the rectangle it's drawn in, without moving the rectangle: the sprite flips in place whatever its origin, rotation and scale. |
| [Texture](Texture.md) | class | Represents a 2D texture resource. |
| [Vertex](Vertex.md) | record struct | A corner of a triangle for [`SpriteBatch.DrawTriangles`](SpriteBatch.md#drawtriangles). |
